summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. All 84 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 digests, and all five computations reproduced. Table S4b reports 537 genes higher at P12 and 326 higher at P35 across both sexes. The registered contrast uses female neuronal pools only. The authors’ code defines that contrast, but the public sources checked supplied no gene-level estimates for it. [Study and supplements](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9519050/), [author code archive](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6517177)
openIssues: Author concordance remains unassessed until a labelled female neuronal P35-versus-P12 result or an identifiable saved author fit becomes available.
